basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old digital marketing student from Manchester, NH, who recently rediscovered my love for Pokémon Go. Outside of gaming, I have a keen interest in fishing and often spend weekends at the local lakes. I am also trying to learn more about aerodynamics, as I find the physics behind it fascinating. I work part-time at a coffee shop, which gives me some free time to engage with online communities. Typically, I'm online during the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy meeting new people through shared interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge is mostly self-taught through online resources and community interactions. I'm still learning the ropes of Reddit and mainly browse subreddits related to my interests like Pokémon Go, fishing, and aerodynamics.
